items.headline: Jets without WR Adonai Mitchell (finger) vs. Lions
items.description: Jets wide receiver Adonai Mitchell is inactive Sunday because of a finger injury.

items.headline: Jets elevate Sterling Shepard with Adonai Mitchell in question
items.description: The Jets promoted veteran Sterling Shepard from the practice squad, as starting WR Adonai Mitchell is questionable with a finger injury, and three other Jets receivers are on injured reserve.

items.description: Touchdowns for Kenneth Walker III and Xavier Worthy? The Broncos pulling an upset of the Rams? Fantasy value for C.J. Stroud? And a big day from Geno Smith?

items.headline: The unshakable bond between Aaron Glenn and Dan Campbell
items.description: Aaron Glenn and Dan Campbell grew up playing and then coaching in the NFL. When Campbell made Glenn his DC, their bond was sealed.

items.headline: HC Aaron Glenn returns to Detroit
items.description: Rich Cimini talks about how personal it is for head coach Aaron Glenn to face his former team in Detroit.
